summary: Layer 1B expands the underfollowed discovery lane for the AI optics/photonics materials node. Reference anchors remain Broadcom and Arista for AI networking demand context, but the candidate list is intentionally focused on smaller US-listed assets closer to niche chokepoints: InP substrates, optical engines/light sources, and silicon-photonics reliability/test capacity. No buy/sell recommendation is made; this is a research universe expansion only.
